In the last week of October 2026, Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman undertook a four-day visit to Japan, where he held a bilateral summit with his Japanese counterpart, Sanae Takaichi. The joint statement covered a wide array of dimensions. However, an under-examined aspect of Tarique Rahman’s recently concluded visit is how Japan remains poised to act as a potential bridge between India and Bangladesh. Watch Bantirani Patro explain in her column how Tokyo can use good faith in both New Delhi and Dhaka to generate confidence in the wider India-Bangladesh ties.
